summary_md:
**Planos ([@trenchplanet](https://x.com/trenchplanet/status/2115432279048671441))** open-sourced **MOGFIELD**, his open take on Higgsfield: an all-in-one AI film studio built on ComfyUI (posted under ComfyUI's #OpenSourceHiggsfield challenge), runnable in Comfy Cloud or locally.

Features he lists include his own take on genjutsu, ReFrame, ReStyle, a Character Builder that auto-creates a character board from one image, and an **Agent mode** that drafts storyboards and scripts with you and generates multiple shots at once.
